title: Migrante: Rescue Filipinos allegedly recruited into Russian military
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Migrant workers’ group Migrante International on Saturday criticized the Marcos administration over its alleged failure to rescue Filipinos recruited for supposed civilian jobs…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Migrant workers’ group Migrante International on Saturday criticized the Marcos administration over its alleged failure to rescue Filipinos recruited for supposed civilian jobs in Russia but later forced into military service amid the country’s war with Ukraine. The group’s statement came after a video showing about 30 Filipinos wearing Russian military uniforms circulating
